name: go

allocations.name: go
allocations.purpose: Go checksum database and isolated tool state

notes: Use the project's CGO setting. GOTOOLCHAIN=local uses the installed compiler; a required different Go version is a prerequisite, not permission evidence. Preserve module/workspace files. Both caches support concurrent Go processes. GOPATH isolates checksum-database checkpoints (pkg/sumdb) and any project-required Go tool state; relocating GOMODCACHE alone is insufficient for cold dependency verification. Keep source and project outputs in the checkout.
